Both plots share a common x-axis labeled "Steps", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, and tick labels at intervals of 100. The top plot illustrates the relationship between steps and training rewards for an "Easy" training set. It contains two lines: a blue line representing "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and a red line representing "Llama-LUFFY-Easy". The blue line begins at approximately (0, 0.18) and increases to approximately (500, 0.32), exhibiting fluctuations throughout. The red line starts at approximately (0, 0.05) and increases to approximately (500, 0.35), also with fluctuations. Both lines are solid and are accompanied by shaded regions indicating variability. 

The bottom plot illustrates the relationship between steps and training rewards for a "Hard" training set. It also contains two lines: a blue line representing "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" and a red line representing "Llama-LUFFY-Hard". The blue line begins at approximately (0, 0.02) and increases to approximately (500, 0.12), with consistent fluctuations.
